feature: Merge Coreport-Project app (keep UI + domain endpoints)
description: Bring over the best parts of budaesandrei/coreport-project (frontend application UI + backend projects/invitations/entities APIs) into this repo, while removing AWS-only infra assumptions.
steps: Clone and inspect budaesandrei/coreport-project branches (dev/uat/main) and identify the 'application' frontend + backend routers to port.
Port frontend 'application' into coreport/frontend (or adjust monorepo structure accordingly), preserving routing, Theme/User context, and MUI layout.
Port backend routers (projects, invitations, entity_types, entity_attributes, providers, project_users) into coreport/backend under app/api/v1/endpoints (or equivalent).
Ensure backend still starts locally via docker compose and exposes Swagger at http://localhost:8000/docs.

description: At http://localhost:3000 user can click Login and authenticate with email+password (local dev). Invitations flow should still work.
steps: Decide auth approach for dev: (A) cognito-local + aws-amplify, or (B) local DB users + JWT.
Implement docker-compose services needed (auth provider + email capture or fake SNS).
Implement backend endpoints for signup/login/invite acceptance (or adapt existing invitation flow).
Implement frontend login page/button and session persistence.
Verify end-to-end: register/login works in browser, and API calls are authenticated.

feature: Portal: project/tenant creation + initial seeded templates
description: On first login, user can create/select a Project/Tenant, and see template Entities + Report Packages preloaded.
steps: Define core tables: tenants/projects, users, memberships, entities, report_packages/types/fields.
Add seed script to create: default tenant/project + sample property entities + 'Financial Package' templates.
Add frontend screens to create/select project/tenant and browse templates.
Verify in UI after login: you can create/select a project and see seeded data.

description: Replace current SVG logo with a more professional mark and apply consistently in the UI.
steps: (Orchestrator) Generate a new logo asset via an image model (or design directly as SVG).
Verify it renders crisply at 24/32/48px on light/dark backgrounds.
